subject.title: fix(media): make wake-false direct fallback reason-aware

question: Is the internal-path Mantis evidence acceptable proof for this PR, or must the contributor provide visible/live gateway-channel proof before merge?
rationale: The code path is internal and the normal Telegram Desktop proof lane reports it cannot expose the behavior, so automation cannot safely decide whether the proof gate should be waived for this external PR.

options.title: Require visible/live proof
options.body: Keep this PR blocked until redacted Telegram, gateway, log, or terminal evidence shows baseline missing or blocking the generated media and the candidate delivering exactly once.

options.title: Accept internal-path proof
options.body: Treat the scheduler matrix plus Mantis fixed=true manifest as sufficient for this internal failure mode and proceed with normal maintainer merge review.
